positive_properties.detail: Candidate treats R8 content hashes as evidence, not issuer permission; owner-journal membership is independently checked
Requires persisted (issuer epoch, atomic sequence) unique across identical AT07 content and restarts, collision/integrity refusal
Proposes BUILD_REGISTER → INVOCATION_SEAL → SITE_USE_REGISTER before first owner-native rule construction
Binds actual conditioner and 16-key witness canonical null separately from static AT07_FIXTURE_ONLY
Proposes owner journal resolution, revocation/expiry/rotation/reissuance and historical audit-only vs current positive replay
Explicit threat model ordinary untrusted caller/mapping/fixture, not hostile arbitrary same-interpreter code; does not import F7 guarantees

blocking_defect.finding: Root bootstrap/provisioning is circularly deferred to an unspecified 'authorized bootstrap' and an 'owner deployment trust-root manifest'. The candidate says the issuer epoch is 'allocated and approved only after HQ adoption', but freezes neither an identity-bearing governed bootstrap authorization/record nor the exact competent operation and custody transition by which the verifier independently receives its initial trust root and revocation/rotation roots.

direct_candidate_evidence.text: HQ-adopted warrant exact ref plus owner deployment trust-root manifest pinned by authorized bootstrap; approve root rotation by explicit governed event
Separately pinned owner-side trust root and exact immutable registration journal resolver
No owner.bootstrap_verifier_root or authority-verified deployment event included
Adoption stated to authorize trust bootstrap, but no exact root-registration proof contract

blocking_defect.hostile_witness: Two noncaller-independent deployment/journal roots can each claim to be 'pinned by authorized bootstrap' under the same eventually adopted warrant. Without an exact HQ-approved bootstrap event tuple or registry record and verification rule, a later implementer has to invent which one owns issuance; a syntactically correct same-content receipt and an untrusted root cannot be distinguished by existing law.
blocking_defect.do_not_overclaim: Candidate openly has null actual exact issuer/ref/root and no operational registrar, correctly because proposal is unadopted. That alone is NOT the defect. Missing is the normative delegation + identity-bearing bootstrap and rotation authority protocol necessary BEFORE implementer can instantiate one.
minimal_correction: Define precisely which HQ authorized action/record provisions initial registrar writer and verifier reader roots following adoption, rather than using the undefined phrase 'authorized bootstrap'.

Freeze a proposed immutable bootstrap receipt projection: adopted warrant ref, delegated issuer exact identity, epoch ref and unique epoch allocation, registrar writer authority, independently provisioned verifier trust-root identity/owner-journal anchor, authority of approver, exact approval event/commit, and verification/activation state. Candidate placeholder identities allowed null until adoption, but field law cannot be unspecified.

Fix who may append, attest or rotate root and how independent verifier obtains authoritative root across processes/restarts, what exact adopted/approved parent event each rotation binds, negative revocation and historical root lookup.

Specify registration power cannot originate in the same caller-provided registry, fixture, test helper, token, material hash or claim from provider request; fail closed for missing/unbootstrapped epoch or forked roots.
Retain ordinary caller threat model and explicitly require stronger separate authority if hostile privileged Python code is within threat set.
blocking_defect.not_a_cryptographic_requirement: Candidate may validly choose trusted append-only journal membership instead of public-key signing for the stated ordinary-caller threat model. It must nevertheless fix who creates/provisions the independent trust anchor and exact governing approval trail.

hostile_cases.case: copied correct journal receipt with caller-supplied registry
unsanctioned verifier root fork under same warrant
registrar/writer identity changes without attested rotation
issuer revoked; exact receipt remains serialized
arbitrary hostile code in trusted Python process

attack_scope: Static documentary review, no actual registrar or adversarial execution, no credentials
